description_en: Creates an application in an ECS cluster
description_zh: 调用InsertApplication接口在ECS集群中创建应用
name: InsertApplication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS cluster. Specify this parameter to create the application in a specific ECS cluster. If you leave this parameter empty, the application is created in the default cluster. We recommend that you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: ECS集群ID。ECS集群ID不为空，则为指定的ECS集群创建应用，为空则为默认集群创建应用（推荐指定）
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The build package number of EDAS-Container. This parameter is required when you create a High-speed Service Framework (HSF) application. You can obtain the build package number in one of the following ways:

Call the ListBuildPack operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149391.html.

Obtain the build package number from the Build Package Number column in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92614.html table
parameters.help_zh:
EDAS-Container构建包号，当创建HSF应用时，该参数必须指定。有以下两种获取方式：

通过容器版本列表接口ListBuildPack获取，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149391.html。

在参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92614.html表格中的**构建包序号**列获取
parameters.name: build_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the application. The name can contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It must start with a letter and can be up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称。仅允许使用数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_） ，而且必须以英文字母开头，最长36个字符
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en: \(Deprecated)\ The reserved port of the application
parameters.help_zh: （废弃参数）应用预留端口号
parameters.name: reserved_port_str

parameters.help_en: The \`ecu\_id\` of the ECS instance to which you want to scale out the application. The \`ecu\_id\` is the unique ID of an ECS instance that is imported to EDAS. To specify multiple \`ecu\_id\`s, separate them with commas (,). You can call the ListScaleOutEcu operation to query the \`ecu\_id\`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149371.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要扩容的ECS实例的`ecu_id`（导入EDAS的ECS实例在EDAS中的唯一身份），多个`ecu_id`用英文逗号（,）分开。`ecu_id`可通过查询ListScaleOutEcu接口获取，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149371.html
parameters.name: ecu_info

parameters.help_en: \(Deprecated)\ The number of CPU cores for the application container in a Swarm cluster
parameters.help_zh: （废弃参数）Swarm集群应用容器CPU核数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: \(Deprecated)\ The memory size for the application container in a Swarm cluster
parameters.help_zh: （废弃参数）Swarm集群应用容器Memory大小
parameters.name: mem

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the microservices namespace. In the EDAS console, choose Resource Management > Microservices Namespace in the navigation pane on the left to view the ID of the microservices namespace. You can also call the ListUserDefineRegion operation to query the ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149377.html.

If the specified cluster is not in the default microservices namespace, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the \`application regionId is different with cluster regionId!\` error is reported.

If the cluster is in the default microservices namespace, you do not need to specify this parameter. The microservices namespace of the application must be the same as the microservices namespace of the specified cluster
parameters.help_zh:
微服务空间ID，您可在EDAS控制台左侧菜单栏选择资源管理 > 微服务空间，找到目标微服务空间对应的微服务空间ID，也可通过ListUserDefineRegion接口获取到微服务空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149377.html。
 
如果指定的集群不在默认微服务空间下，则需要指定该参数，否则会遇到`application regionId is different with cluster regionId!`的错误提示。
如果在默认微服务空间下，则不需要指定。该参数需要与指定的集群ID所在的微服务空间保持一致
parameters.name: logical_region_id

parameters.help_en: (Deprecated) The version of the Java Development Kit (JDK) that the application uses
parameters.help_zh: （废弃参数）  用来指定应用使用的JDK版本
parameters.name: jdk

parameters.help_en: (Deprecated) The version of Apache Tomcat
parameters.help_zh: （废弃参数） 用于指定Apache Tomcat版本
parameters.name: web_container

parameters.help_en: The format of the application deployment package. Valid values: war and jar
parameters.help_zh: 应用部署包格式，可设置为war或者jar
parameters.name: package_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application component. You can call the ListComponents operation to query the component ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97502.html.

This parameter is required if the application runs in an Apache Tomcat container (for Dubbo applications that are deployed in a WAR package) or a standard Java application runtime environment (for Spring Boot or Spring Cloud applications that are deployed in a JAR package).

The following application component IDs are commonly used:

4: Apache Tomcat 7.0.91

7: Apache Tomcat 8.5.42

5: OpenJDK 1.8.x

6: OpenJDK 1.7.x

To set this parameter, you must update the Java or Python software development kit (SDK) to version 2.57.3 or later. If you do not use an EDAS SDK, such as aliyun-python-sdk-core, aliyun-java-sdk-core, or Alibaba Cloud CLI, you can set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
应用组件ID。可通过查询组件列表接口ListComponents接口获取，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97502.html。

当创建的应用运行环境使用Apache Tomcat（适用于WAR包部署的Dubbo应用）或者标准Java应用运行环境（适用于JAR包部署的Spring Boot或Spring Cloud应用）时需要指定。

常用的应用组件ID及含义：

4：Apache Tomcat 7.0.91
7：Apache Tomcat 8.5.42
5：表示OpenJDK 1.8.x
6：表示 OpenJDK 1.7.x

该参数需要更新Java或者Python SDK版本到2.57.3或以上版本才可以设置，未使用EDAS提供的SDK的（例如在使用aliyun-python-sdk-core、aliyun-java-sdk-core、aliyun cli等）用户可直接设置该参数
parameters.name: component_ids

`[{"ignoreFail":false,"name":"postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut","script":"ls"},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"postdeleteInstanceDataOnScaleIn","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestopInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststopInstance","script":""}]`
parameters.help_zh:
挂载脚本配置，为一段JSON格式文本，如：
`[{"ignoreFail":false,"name":"postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut","script":"ls"},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"postdeleteInstanceDataOnScaleIn","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestopInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststopInstance","script":""}]`
